skill_name: Summarize a website about delivering food from restaurant to local people.
workflow: Restaurant delivery is a service that allows customers to order food online from restaurants for delivery. These services are available through apps or websites which allow customers to search for restaurants by cuisine, distance, ratings, and more. Customers can order food and pay for it through the app or website and the restaurant then delivers the food to the customer's door. Delivery times vary depending on the restaurant.
